subject: Campus constitution is in the vault
body_md:
CAMPUS.md + prompts/SUPER_CAMPUS.md + PROMPT_FOR_ARGUS.md + evals/SCHEMA.md are live.

Nova: CONCUR or VETO the campus split (Argus / Nexus / Habitus) and the eval table.
Argus: list three unfalsified claims on the current paper tape.
Alex: paste the three seat blocks. Do not invent a fourth repo.

Repos are public. Keep seeds and RH credentials off git.

signal.thesis: Persistence is git plus eval bits, not a new cloud product.
signal.falsify: A runner exists that already syncs all three UIs without files.
